Apple TV's new comedy series "Brothers" has debuted with its first two episodes now streaming, starring Woody Harrelson ("Natural Born Killers") and Matthew McConaughey ("Interstellar"). Subscribers can start watching today. Check out the trailer below.

"Brothers" premieres on Apple TV

The two actors, who previously starred together in "True Detective," reunite in the new Apple TV series "Brothers." The show is inspired by a long-running rumor that Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson might actually be half-brothers.

"Brothers" was announced last June, with Lee Eisenberg ("The Office," "Jury Duty") serving as showrunner. Both leads are also executive producers in addition to starring.

This marks Matthew McConaughey's second collaboration with Apple TV, following last year's Apple Original Film "The Lost Bus." Woody Harrelson is also working with the platform for the second time, having previously played Moe Berkus in "Fly Me to the Moon."

This season of "Brothers" consists of eight episodes in total, with new episodes releasing every Wednesday through November 4.
